title: Direct image of pro-etale module sheaves
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and let $A$ be a commutative ring. Use the small pro-etale sites $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the constant sheaves of rings $A_X$, $A_Y$ and the abelian categories $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ of sheaves of $A_X$-, resp. $A_Y$-modules defined there. For an object $V\to Y$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ the base change $V\times_YX\to X$ is weakly etale [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] (flatness and flatness of the diagonal are stable under base change), so $u_f(V)=V\times_YX$ is an object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and $V\mapsto u_f(V)$ is a functor $u_f:Y_{\mathrm{proet}}\to X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ which carries coverings to coverings and commutes with fibre products. For a sheaf $F$ of $A_X$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the *direct image* $f_*F$ is the presheaf

$$
 (f_*F)(V)=F(V\times_YX),\qquad V\in Y_{\mathrm{proet}},
$$

with restriction maps those of $F$ along $u_f$; it is a sheaf on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and it is an $A_Y$-module through the map of sheaves of rings $A_Y\to f_*A_X$ induced, by the universal property of sheafification, from the map of constant presheaves $A\to A_X(V\times_YX)$. On morphisms $f_*$ acts by $(f_*\varphi)_V=\varphi_{V\times_YX}$. This defines an additive functor

$$
 f_*:\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\longrightarrow\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A).
$$

external.place: Definition 4.1.1 (weakly etale), Lemma 4.1.6 (base changes of weakly etale maps are weakly etale), Section 4.1 (the site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$); the direct image is the pushforward along the base-change functor of small sites
Section on morphisms of ringed topoi, pushforward $f_*$ of modules (Tag 03D7 for its adjunction)
